en.t: There was no way this sealed move could not be found.

units.source_text: 可是八幡却慌里慌张地窥视棋谱寻找，一时竟找不到。

en.t: But Yawata, flustered and frantic, peered through the game record searching for it, and for a while he simply could not find it.

units.source_text: 好不容易找着了，才喊出“啊”的一声。

en.t: Only after finally finding it did he let out an “ah.”
